compose_video_transforms: apply a sequence of video transforms in order using Compose on a video file
compose_video_with_seed: apply Compose transforms to a video with a fixed random seed for reproducibility
compose_video_with_metadata: apply Compose transforms to a video and collect execution metadata into a list
oneof_video_transform: randomly select and apply one transform from a list using OneOf on a video
oneof_video_with_probability: apply OneOf with a custom probability p to control whether a transform is applied
